name: Painter core
responsibility: Draws a typed scene on a canvas and works out every move from one picture to the next, as plain Rust with no DOM and no GPU of its own
description: One Canvas trait serves Vello on the GPU and Vello on the CPU, so both run the same walk over the scene (ADR 0071). The in-between of two scenes is a pure function of the scenes and a progress value, so Rust tests own it. A host tells the stage what changed and what time it is, and asks for frames.
